evidence_scope.exact: Finite checks corroborate handwritten conditional projection/parameterization/transaction proofs.
evidence_scope.optimization: Toy declared A objectives, actual stored endpoints and complete local D domains; no universal learning or long-term guarantee.
evidence_scope.optimizer: Declared host proposal arithmetic is separate from protected BF16/FP32 execution.
evidence_scope.BF16: Software RNE, not native BF16 certification.
evidence_scope.FP32: Local scalar CPU operations audited against exact rational RNE.
evidence_scope.transactions: Trusted serial combined-state publication and refusal rollback; no cryptographic caller authentication or general concurrency.
evidence_scope.excluded: GPU, arbitrary compiler optimization, process-failure atomicity, full machine proof and later P2 stages.
